golden.method: 30 posts picked at random within each source (seed 2070). Answer key drafted blind by Claude (Opus 5.5) from the post text only, before seeing the engine's answers, then reviewed by the team, who set 2 labels themselves and corrected 2.
golden.caveat: The v11 fixes were made after looking at these same 30 posts, so the 'after' scores are optimistic until checked on posts the fixes have not seen.
